meta.title: A closed event cannot be bid on

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary; the event and its two bids already exist.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the prepared closed RFQ from Vendor A's vendor event list on its pricing round.
Try to change Vendor A's existing price without submitting; the attempt must be refused because the closed bid sheet is read-only.
Assert that the vendor cannot submit a quote on the closed event.
Assert that the vendor view displays the event's closed status.
